title: The master sends a new account to a shard with a one-time ticket, keeps s0 people home, refuses sign-ups no shard can take before any session exists, holds one label across shards, and keeps the zone and the update turns in step
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd` with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a scratch Postgres. Cloudflare, the shards and the zone are local doubles; nothing leaves the machine.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.
fence: The channel refuses a bad signature, clock or replay with a reason; the adopt call carries the nonce hash and never the nonce; a person no shard can take gets 503 NO_SHARD_ACCEPTING with no session and no directory row; an s0 person is never moved; two shards asking for one label get exactly one; a name pointing elsewhere is flagged, never overwritten; at most two shards update at once and a failed one waits an hour; the shard pointer is host-only and a customer site can never set one of Tracy cookies. Throwaway Postgres and local doubles, no network.

tests: the four refusals: unknown_shard, clock, signature, replay
a POST is the host channel's string byte for byte: tracy-host's verifier accepts it
the shard pointer is host-only: __Host- over https, unprefixed on a plain-HTTP stand, never a Domain
sign-out keeps the shard pointer and clears a handoff nonce the browser presented
on the master, sign-out clears every tracy_sess_<n> the browser presents, and nothing that only looks like one
a new person goes to the emptiest shard by a signed call that carries the nonce hash and next, never the nonce
a full shard is passed for the next one once, without being marked degraded or told
NOT_A_SHARD, MIRROR_CONFLICT and BAD_BODY end the round: no other shard is asked, nothing is marked degraded, and shard.adopt_failed names the shard and the code
when both refuse, nobody takes the person: no row, no place here either, and the ops topic hears it
an s0 person stays here whatever the pointer says, but a shard they were invited onto hands them over
a fresh start with no other shard able to take them is refused: no new row, their place kept, and the ops topic hears it
a person with no display name and no language is adopted by a real shard door, and nothing is marked degraded
no shard able to take a new person: an empty table changes nothing; shards all unfit refuse them before any session, told once a quarter hour
signed in, both shards refusing a new person is NO_SHARD_ACCEPTING: the page, with the session and the pointer taken back
a verified code asks the shard hook before any session: the pointer, then the session, on one answer; a refusal is the hook answer and mints none
only the pages a person works on move: home, new, sites, account and a site key
the master answers: no pointer, an unknown pointer, a fetch, a POST, a sign-in door, another host
every refused signature is 403 SIGNATURE_INVALID with why: signature, unknown_shard or clock
a replayed request is refused as a replay, and a body that is not a JSON object is a 400
two shards asking for one label at the same moment: exactly one gets it
a label another holder has, or this master uses, is LABEL_TAKEN, told to the ops topic, and nothing is written
a name already pointing elsewhere is listed as a DNS conflict: 200, told once to the ops topic, the record untouched
site.deleted: only by its own shard; the name, the own domains and the row all go
a kind outside the closed set, a domain event, a bad id or time, or missing data is BAD_EVENT and is not remembered
another shard s site is UNKNOWN_SITE; a domain held elsewhere is DOMAIN_TAKEN with its holder; a Tracy name is a bad request; no SaaS is CLOUDFLARE
at most two shards update at once, each with a turn that ends; a shard already on its way keeps it; a finished one frees it
a shard backing off after a failed update gets no turn for an hour
the hourly pass writes what is missing, flags what points elsewhere, finishes deletes and removes orphans only
an admin adds a shard: sealed, closed, its secret never echoed; a taken name or origin and a bad field add nothing
on a Tracy address the site keeps its own cookies and loses every one of Tracy’s
